# Alvento

> Alvento builds and operates practical AI-assisted business workflows.

Alvento Ltd is a UK company (Company No. 16394298), founded and run by Oscar Espinoza. Independent specialists can be included per engagement depending on requirements, availability and cost.

## Delivery models

Managed services: Alvento runs the workflow and delivers agreed outputs. Bespoke builds: ownership, licensing, hosting, handover and support are agreed commercially. White-label solutions: software or services under another business’s brand. Pricing differs by delivery model. Automation, human review and escalation rules are agreed per workflow.

## Services and enquiries

- [Services and engagement models](https://alvento.uk/#engagement): content production, workflow automation, bespoke and white-label development.
- [Workflow examples](https://alvento.uk/clinical-registries/): possible applications and an owned reference build, not evidence of external clinical deployments.
- [AI-search visibility](https://alvento.uk/aeo/): public-content and discoverability work with sampled answer monitoring; no guaranteed citations.
- [Website review](https://alvento.uk/website-audit/): scoped accessibility, SEO, performance and security-posture checks, not certification or a full audit.

## Paid client work

- [Content production](https://alvento.uk/case-studies/#content-production): anonymous European heating and water-treatment brand; 32 social posts monthly, eight for each of four countries.
- [Staamp at Lizette’s](https://alvento.uk/case-studies/staamp/): customer loyalty at an independent coffee shop. Dated usage figures describe usage, not revenue or retention uplift.

## Available products

- [Staamp](https://alvento.uk/case-studies/staamp/): browser-based loyalty cards and staff-approved stamps. Setup and adaptations separately scoped.
- [Portraix](https://portraix.com): available AI headshot product, formerly ioomm.app. One product under its current name.

## Alvento-owned reference builds

These are not external client deployments.
- [Foyer](https://alvento.uk/case-studies/foyer/): fictional businesses, synthetic sample calls and simulated bookings.
- [Arrears](https://alvento.uk/case-studies/arrears/): fictional invoices, captured emails and simulated payments.
- [Immunaris](https://alvento.uk/case-studies/immunaris/): sample vaccination records and demonstration workflows, not proof of compliance or certification.

## Other products and concepts

[Wren, Kestrel, Licit and Score API](https://alvento.uk/case-studies/#experiments): commercial availability remains unverified. Restricted public requests alone do not establish that a product is broken.
[PSUR Draft Generator](https://alvento.uk/projects/psur-draft-generator/): unbuilt concept, separate from the available free outline tool.

## Free tools

[Eight browser-based tools](https://alvento.uk/tools/): PDF to Markdown, SOP to Checklist, UDI Decoder, CPD Activity Tracker, MDR Class Check, MDR PSUR Outline Generator, MDR Technical File Index and PSBAR Accessibility Statement Generator. Documents are processed locally. Optional page analytics is separate and loads only after acceptance. The Technical File Index exports Markdown and a Word-ready HTML .doc file, not .docx. Tools do not establish regulatory compliance.
